Checklist:

* [ ] Either
    * I've created an [Feature Request](https://github.com/cyclops-k8s/ansible-kubernetes/issues/new/choose) and discussed it with the community.
    * This is a bug fix.
    * This does not need to be in the release notes.
* [ ] The title of the PR states what changed.
* [ ] I've included "Closes [ISSUE #]" or "Fixes [ISSUE #]" in the description to automatically close the associated issue.
* [ ] If required, I've updated the documentation, or I plan to submit a second PR with documentation updates.
* [ ] I have added a brief description of why this PR is necessary and/or what this PR solves if the issue/title is not descriptive enough.
